FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 151
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Curtis Travis
Security
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/10/2025
House Bill 151 as introduced would expand the eligibility for the current firefighter distinctive
license plate to include the issuance of one plate to certain fire chaplains. This bill would also
increase the administrative obligations of the Department of Revenue to carry out the provisions
of this bill.
